statusDetail: Coverage complete. Six representative paths cover homepage/listing, Jodi chart, panel chart, interactive forum, contact form, and HTTP error recovery. Other market chart URLs were excluded because they share these templates; APK execution, account login, and real-money off-site phone transactions were not performed for safety.

page.notes: Public gambling-results/content site with a very long homepage, many chart templates, a user-generated guessing forum and a contact form.

paths.description: Homepage and live-results listing, the primary result-checking journey and representative long listing template.
Kalyan Jodi chart detail, representative of the many historical chart pages; equivalent market chart templates were de-duplicated.
Kalyan panel chart detail, representative of panel-table pages distinct from Jodi charts.
Guessing forum, the primary interactive/user-generated and commercial-risk surface.
Contact form, representative form and validation path.
Unknown route, representative HTTP error and recovery state.

findings.summary: The page does not adapt its palette to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are visually identical; DOM CSS contains no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule, while large white panels remain bright.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and define preference-driven surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), preserving contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion mode leaves non-essential transform and disclosure transitions enabled.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe matched reduce but still found transform 0.2s/0.3s and multiple 0.3s card transitions; there is no reduced-motion override.
findings.suggestedFix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove non-essential transforms and shorten or eliminate disclosure transitions.

findings.summary: Navigation between the long listing and chart details swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across homepage and chart templates found no view-transition-name, @view-transition, or document.startViewTransition use.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The 17,784px homepage provides no persistent location or progress aid.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured a 17,784px document; screenshot and DOM show no sticky navigation, progress indicator, or scroll-state-aware chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Add compact sticky navigation or a scroll progress/location aid that reacts to scroll state without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Repeated generic “Jodi” and “Panel” links do not identify their destinations.
findings.evidence: Recon enumerated scores of consecutive links whose accessible/visible text is only “Jodi” or “Panel”, forcing users to infer the associated market from surrounding layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each link a destination-specific name such as “Kalyan Jodi chart” and preserve a clear current-location cue on details.

findings.summary: Dense borders, gradients, shadows, competing colors and repeated calls-to-action overwhelm the result content.
findings.evidence: Desktop/mobile screenshots show nearly every block using a different heavy border, fill, shadow and text treatment; the first viewport has several competing result, refresh and play treatments.
findings.suggestedFix: Establish a restrained hierarchy with shared surface tokens, fewer borders/shadows, one primary action style and more whitespace around result content.

findings.summary: Repeated cards respond only through page-wide viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: Captured CSS uses max-width viewport media queries but contains no @container/container-type rules, despite reusable cards and link panels appearing in varied contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Make reusable cards and navigation panels size containers and adapt typography/layout with container queries.

findings.summary: Many links are too small or tightly packed for reliable touch use.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size failed; footer links are 17px tall with safe clickable diameters as low as 0–23.6px. The direct probe also measured repeated Jodi links at about 35×21px.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every actionable link at least a 24×24 CSS-pixel target with adequate separation, preferably 44×44 for primary mobile actions.

findings.summary: The forum composer lacks an associated accessible label; repeated decorative images also omit alt semantics.
findings.evidence: Forum form probe found the Comm textarea with no label, placeholder or accessible-name attribute. The image audit found 10 repeated arrow GIFs with no alt attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate a real label with the textarea and use alt="" for decorative arrows (or meaningful alt only when the image conveys content).

findings.summary: Typography and information density impede scanning and comprehension.
findings.evidence: Screenshots show long centered/italic paragraphs, all-caps forum rules, tiny table headings, text shadows and tightly packed mixed-color content; the homepage reaches 17,784px on mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a readable system font, left-align prose, remove text shadows/forced italics, constrain line length, and provide clear section spacing and typography tokens.

findings.summary: A prominent animated image is displayed above its intrinsic resolution.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse image-size-responsive failed: the 25×11 GIF is displayed at 38×17 and should provide about 57×26 physical pixels for the tested density.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the indicator with SVG/CSS or provide an appropriately sized responsive image.

findings.summary: HTTPS is used, but browser security defenses and session-cookie hardening are largely absent.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking control, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. PHPSESSID is Secure but HttpOnly is false and SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, CSP (including frame-ancestors), nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark the session cookie HttpOnly and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Forum timestamps are ambiguous and not exposed as locale/time-zone-aware data.
findings.evidence: Rendered posts use strings such as “22 Jul 09:05:49 pm” without <time datetime>, year/time-zone context or an indicated user locale; the forum probe contains no machine-readable timestamp representation.
findings.suggestedFix: Render timestamps with Intl.DateTimeFormat for the user locale and include a machine-readable ISO datetime plus explicit time-zone context.

findings.summary: The site’s “100% free” promise conflicts with prominent paid-membership solicitations and guaranteed-win claims.
findings.evidence: Homepage copy says “100% free” and “No payment.” The forum’s top/admin posts repeatedly claim “Guarantee 100% Fix,” “Office Se Game Milega,” and “To Book Your Membership,” with phone numbers. This can induce financial harm in a gambling context.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove guaranteed-win and paid-membership solicitations, enforce the stated forum rules, clearly distinguish user content, disclose moderation/financial risk, and keep claims consistent with the free-service promise.

findings.summary: Contact identity fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Contact probe found required name and email inputs with empty autocomplete values.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete="name" and autocomplete="email" to reduce typing and improve autofill.

findings.summary: Decorative assets use legacy GIFs and below-fold images are eagerly loaded.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found 10 legacy GIFs and 10 below-fold images without lazy loading, although the total transfer is a very small 29,835 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Prefer SVG/CSS for arrow decorations and lazy-load non-critical below-fold images while retaining explicit dimensions.

taskList.title: Remove guaranteed-win and paid-membership solicitations; enforce forum rules and risk disclosure
Harden response headers and the PHP session cookie
Replace the dense visual system with a restrained, legible hierarchy
Increase mobile target sizes and use destination-specific link names
Fix forum labels, decorative image alternatives, and contact autocomplete
Add preference-aware color and reduced-motion styles
Add long-page navigation aids and container-aware components
Expose locale- and time-zone-correct machine-readable timestamps
Modernize small decorative assets and image loading
